name: machine-machine-payments
description: Scaffold-HBAR Agent & Machine Payments template with on-chain Vault consensus spend controls and x402 micropayments

envVars.description: Hedera network to interact with (testnet or mainnet)
Hedera account ID for autonomous AI agent (0.0.X)
Hedera private key for autonomous AI agent
Optional spending guard mode: auto, offchain, or vault (default: auto)
Optional Hedera Consensus Service topic ID for agent spend audit trail
Optional HCS-2 versioned policy registry topic ID (0.0.X)
Optional deployed HSCS Vault contract ID (0.0.X) for consensus spend enforcement
Optional facilitator flavor: hosted (default Blocky402) or self-hosted (/api/x402/facilitator)
Optional fee-payer Hedera Account ID (0.0.X) for self-hosted facilitator
Optional fee-payer Hedera Private Key for self-hosted facilitator fee sponsorship
Optional custom facilitator URL (defaults to https://api.testnet.blocky402.com)
Optional deployed HSCS AgentRegistry contract address (0x...) for on-chain agent identity verification
Optional HCS topic ID (0.0.X) for recording agent trust and identity verification audit logs

steps.label: Install dependencies (auto-generates offline keys if missing)
Prepare Vault contract and HCS Audit Topics on Hedera Testnet
